facts.text: The hotel is in Lima's San Isidro financial and shopping district, minutes from restaurants, galleries and parks.
facts.excerpt: Located in the vibrant San Isidro financial and shopping district, The Westin Lima Hotel and Convention Center is minutes from splendid restaurants, galleries, and parks.

facts.text: The hotel is 15 minutes from the Miraflores district and the Historic Center of Lima.
facts.excerpt: conveniently located 15 minutes from the Miraflores district and the Historic Center of Lima

facts.text: Every room has floor-to-ceiling windows with views of downtown.
facts.excerpt: Each of our rooms has floor-to-ceiling windows that offer optimal natural light and invigorating views of downtown.

facts.text: Rooms have the signature Westin Heavenly Beds with crisp sheets and down pillows.
facts.excerpt: Crisp sheets, down pillows and our signature Westin Heavenly Beds ensure a restful sleep

facts.text: Rooms have marble bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a spa experience in the comfort of your own room with marble bathrooms and refreshing bath amenities.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite, on the 30th floor, is decorated with wooden details, Peruvian textiles and colorful art.
facts.excerpt: Exquisite room with city view, decorated with elegant wooden details, Peruvian textiles and colorful art. The Presidential Suite overlooks Lima with grace and style from the 30th floor.

facts.text: The Westin Club lounge is on the 29th floor with views over the city of Lima.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 29th floor of the hotel, our Westin Club has a fantastic view of the city of Lima.

facts.text: The Heavenly Spa by Westin has a heated pool and a thermal circuit.
facts.excerpt: It has 17 treatment rooms, a luxury heated pool and a thermal circuit.

facts.text: The Heavenly Spa has whirlpool suites and a full-service Redken salon.
facts.excerpt: we offer 17 treatment rooms, 4 whirlpool suites, and a full-service Redkin salon

facts.text: The spa is designed in a soft palette of white and green accented by natural woods.
facts.excerpt: With a soft color palette of white and green, accented by natural woods, our spa is designed to revitalize comfort.

facts.text: The spa's Shiatsu Corner offers a 25-minute lesson in traditional Japanese massage.
facts.excerpt: Join us in the Shiatsu Corner for a 25-minute lesson on this traditional Japanese massage.

facts.text: The heated pool is on the second floor.
facts.excerpt: features a heated pool located on the second floor

facts.text: The pool area has blue tile and indoor trees.
facts.excerpt: Blue tile and lush indoor trees add to the serene atmosphere.

facts.text: Alphonse is a speakeasy inspired by Prohibition and Al Capone that serves classic cocktails in vintage glassware with jazz, bossa nova and blues.
facts.excerpt: Alphonse, the only speakeasy in a 5-star hotel, inspired by Prohibition and Al Capone, serves classic cocktails in vintage glassware with jazz, bossa nova, and blues

facts.text: Maras is the hotel's fine-dining restaurant serving Peruvian cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Awaken your senses with innovative Peruvian cuisine at Maras, our elegant fine-dining restaurant in San Isidro

facts.text: The convention center can host up to 1,600 people and has 19 spaces for meetings, events and weddings.
facts.excerpt: boasting the largest in Lima with capacity for up to 1,600 people and 19 spaces for meetings, events, and weddings

facts.text: The fitness studio has TechnoGym strength and resistance machines.
facts.excerpt: Our Fitness Studio is equipped with modern TechnoGym strength and resistance machines.

facts.text: A bilingual concierge team helps with activities in Lima and visits to Machu Picchu.
facts.excerpt: Our bilingual concierge team is always available to assist you with personalized recommendations, from activities in Lima and visits to Machu Picchu

facts.text: Nearby Parque el Olivar has quiet paths among centuries-old olive trees.
facts.excerpt: Stroll through the quiet paths of Parque el Olivar, home to centuries-old olive trees and surrounded by beautiful Germanic mansions.

facts.text: The hotel accepts one dog per room under 18 kilograms for an extra fee.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel only accepts dogs that weigh less than 18 kilograms, with an additional cost of $50 USD plus tax, per night. Only one dog per room allowed.

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

facts.text: The hotel calls its spa the best urban spa in South America.
facts.excerpt: The Heavenly Spa by Westin® is recognized as the best urban spa in South America.

facts.text: The hotel calls its spa the largest urban spa in Latin America.
facts.excerpt: At the largest urban spa in Latin America

facts.text: The hotel holds Biosphere Sustainable certification (no date given).
facts.excerpt: With the Biosphere Sustainable certification, we reaffirm our commitment to the planet and local communities.

facts.text: The spa covers 3000 square meters.
facts.excerpt: Located in an area of ​​3000 m2

facts.text: The spa covers 2800 square meters.
facts.excerpt: With an area of ​​2800 m2
